# ============================================================ # Standalone Shinylive Pathway-Gene Explorer # # Files required in the same directory: # app.R # enrichment.rds # gene_data.rds # # No ivolcano / enrichit / clusterProfiler dependency # ============================================================ library(shiny) library(DT) library(ggplot2) library(ggiraph) # ============================================================ # 1. Load data # ============================================================ enrichment <- readRDS("enrichment.rds") gene_data <- readRDS("gene_data.rds") # ============================================================ # 2. Prepare data # ============================================================ pathway_app_prepare <- function( enrichment, gene_data, pathway_col = "Description", pathway_gene_col = "geneID", pathway_p_col = "p.adjust", pathway_ratio_col = "GeneRatio", gene_col = "symbol", gene_effect_col = "logFC", gene_p_col = "PValue", show_pathways = NULL, gene_id_case = c("asis", "upper", "lower"), pval_cutoff = 0.05, logFC_cutoff = 1 ) { if (!is.data.frame(gene_data)) { stop("gene_data must be a data.frame.", call. = FALSE) } gene_id_case <- match.arg(gene_id_case) # -------------------------------------------------------- # Convert enrichment to data.frame # -------------------------------------------------------- if (is.data.frame(enrichment)) { pathway_df <- enrichment } else { stop( "enrichment must be an ordinary data.frame. ", "Use as.data.frame(ego) before saving enrichment.rds.", call. = FALSE ) } # -------------------------------------------------------- # Check columns # -------------------------------------------------------- missing_pathway <- setdiff( c(pathway_col, pathway_gene_col), names(pathway_df) ) if (length(missing_pathway)) { stop( "Missing enrichment columns: ", paste(missing_pathway, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE ) } missing_gene <- setdiff( c(gene_col, gene_effect_col, gene_p_col), names(gene_data) ) if (length(missing_gene)) { stop( "Missing gene_data columns: ", paste(missing_gene, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE ) } # -------------------------------------------------------- # Normalize gene IDs # -------------------------------------------------------- normalise <- function(x) { x <- trimws(as.character(x)) if (gene_id_case == "upper") { x <- toupper(x) } if (gene_id_case == "lower") { x <- tolower(x) } x } # -------------------------------------------------------- # Split pathway gene IDs # -------------------------------------------------------- split_ids <- function(x) { if (is.list(x)) { x <- unlist(x, use.names = FALSE) } if (!length(x) || all(is.na(x))) { return(character()) } x <- gsub("['\"]+", "", paste(as.character(x), collapse = "/")) ids <- unlist( strsplit( x, "[/;,|]" ), use.names = FALSE ) ids <- ids[ !is.na(ids) & nzchar(trimws(ids)) ] unique(normalise(ids)) } # -------------------------------------------------------- # Parse GeneRatio # -------------------------------------------------------- ratio_value <- function(x) { if (!length(x) || is.na(x)) { return(NA_real_) } if (is.numeric(x)) { return(as.numeric(x)[1]) } bits <- strsplit( as.character(x)[1], "/", fixed = TRUE )[[1]] if (length(bits) != 2) { return( suppressWarnings( as.numeric(x)[1] ) ) } suppressWarnings( as.numeric(bits[1]) / as.numeric(bits[2]) ) } # ======================================================== # Gene table # ======================================================== gene_table <- gene_data gene_table$gene_label <- as.character(gene_table[[gene_col]]) gene_table$gene_key <- normalise(gene_table[[gene_col]]) gene_table$gene_effect <- suppressWarnings( as.numeric( gene_table[[gene_effect_col]] ) ) gene_table$gene_p <- suppressWarnings( as.numeric( gene_table[[gene_p_col]] ) ) # Remove missing gene IDs gene_table <- gene_table[ !is.na(gene_table$gene_key) & nzchar(gene_table$gene_key), , drop = FALSE ] # Keep first occurrence gene_table <- gene_table[ !duplicated(gene_table$gene_key), , drop = FALSE ] # -log10(P) gene_table$neg_log_p <- -log10( pmax( gene_table$gene_p, .Machine$double.xmin ) ) gene_table$neg_log_p[ !is.finite(gene_table$neg_log_p) ] <- 0 # Significance class gene_table$sig <- "NS" gene_table$sig[ gene_table$gene_p < pval_cutoff & gene_table$gene_effect > logFC_cutoff ] <- "Up" gene_table$sig[ gene_table$gene_p < pval_cutoff & gene_table$gene_effect < -logFC_cutoff ] <- "Down" # ======================================================== # Pathway table # ======================================================== pathway_table <- pathway_df[ !is.na(pathway_df[[pathway_col]]), , drop = FALSE ] pathway_table$pathway <- as.character( pathway_table[[pathway_col]] ) pathway_table$pathway_id <- make.unique( pathway_table$pathway ) # Extract genes from each pathway pathway_table$gene_keys <- lapply( pathway_table[[pathway_gene_col]], split_ids ) pathway_table$total_count <- lengths( pathway_table$gene_keys ) # Number of genes that actually occur # in gene_data pathway_table$matched_count <- vapply( pathway_table$gene_keys, function(x) { sum( x %in% gene_table$gene_key ) }, integer(1) ) # FDR if (pathway_p_col %in% names(pathway_table)) { pathway_table$fdr <- suppressWarnings( as.numeric( pathway_table[[pathway_p_col]] ) ) } else { pathway_table$fdr <- NA_real_ } # Gene ratio if (pathway_ratio_col %in% names(pathway_table)) { pathway_table$gene_ratio <- vapply( pathway_table[[pathway_ratio_col]], ratio_value, numeric(1) ) } else { pathway_table$gene_ratio <- NA_real_ } # Sort by FDR pathway_table <- pathway_table[ order( pathway_table$fdr, na.last = TRUE ), , drop = FALSE ] # Limit number of pathways if (!is.null(show_pathways)) { pathway_table <- utils::head( pathway_table, show_pathways ) } pathway_table$gene_keys <- lapply( pathway_table$gene_keys, unique ) # ======================================================== # Display table # ======================================================== pathway_display <- data.frame( Pathway = pathway_table$pathway, FDR = ifelse( is.na(pathway_table$fdr), "NA", format( pathway_table$fdr, digits = 3, scientific = TRUE ) ), GeneRatio = ifelse( is.na(pathway_table$gene_ratio), "NA", format( pathway_table$gene_ratio, digits = 3 ) ), `Matched genes` = pathway_table$matched_count, `Total genes` = pathway_table$total_count, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE ) # ======================================================== # Matching genes # ======================================================== all_pathway_genes <- unique( unlist( pathway_table$gene_keys, use.names = FALSE ) ) matched_gene_keys <- intersect( all_pathway_genes, gene_table$gene_key ) # ======================================================== # Return # ======================================================== list( pathway_table = pathway_table, pathway_display = pathway_display, gene_table = gene_table, matched_gene_keys = matched_gene_keys ) } # ============================================================ # 3. Prepare application data # ============================================================ prepared <- pathway_app_prepare( enrichment = enrichment, gene_data = gene_data, pathway_col = "Description", pathway_gene_col = "geneID", pathway_p_col = "p.adjust", pathway_ratio_col = "GeneRatio", gene_col = "symbol", gene_effect_col = "logFC", gene_p_col = "PValue", #show_pathways = 30, gene_id_case = "asis", pval_cutoff = 0.05, logFC_cutoff = 1 ) # ============================================================ # 4. User Interface # ============================================================ ui <- fluidPage( tags$head( tags$style( HTML( paste0( ".pa-shell{", "max-width:1400px;", "margin:0 auto;", "padding:12px 20px;", "}", ".pa-status{", "padding:8px 12px;", "background:#F8FAFC;", "border:1px solid #E2E8F0;", "border-radius:6px;", "margin:10px 0;", "color:#334155;", "}", ".pa-help{", "color:#64748B;", "font-size:13px;", "margin:4px 0 10px;", "}", ".pa-panel{", "margin-bottom:18px;", "}", ".pa-panel h3{", "margin:8px 0 6px;", "color:#0F172A;", "}" ) ) ) ), div( class = "pa-shell", h2( "Pathway-gene explorer" ), div( class = "pa-help", paste0( "Select one or more pathways in the table ", "to highlight their matched genes in ", "the volcano plot." ) ), # ---------------------------------------------------- # Pathway table # ---------------------------------------------------- div( class = "pa-panel", DTOutput( "pathway_table" ) ), # ---------------------------------------------------- # Selection status # ---------------------------------------------------- div( class = "pa-status", textOutput( "selection_status" ) ), # ---------------------------------------------------- # Volcano plot # ---------------------------------------------------- div( class = "pa-panel", girafeOutput( "volcano", width = "100%", height = "620px" ) ), # ---------------------------------------------------- # Selected genes # ---------------------------------------------------- div( class = "pa-panel", h3( "Selected genes" ), DTOutput( "selected_genes" ) ), # ---------------------------------------------------- # Diagnostics # ---------------------------------------------------- div( class = "pa-panel", h3( "Matching diagnostics" ), verbatimTextOutput( "diagnostics" ) ) ) ) # ============================================================ # 5. Server # ============================================================ server <- function( input, output, session ) { # -------------------------------------------------------- # Selected pathway rows # -------------------------------------------------------- selected_rows <- reactive({ rows <- input$pathway_table_rows_selected if (is.null(rows)) { integer() } else { as.integer(rows) } }) # -------------------------------------------------------- # Genes belonging to selected pathways # -------------------------------------------------------- selected_gene_keys <- reactive({ rows <- selected_rows() if (!length(rows)) { return(character()) } unique( unlist( prepared$pathway_table$gene_keys[rows], use.names = FALSE ) ) }) # -------------------------------------------------------- # Names of selected pathways # -------------------------------------------------------- selected_pathway_names <- reactive({ rows <- selected_rows() if (!length(rows)) { character() } else { prepared$pathway_table$pathway[rows] } }) # ======================================================== # Pathway table # ======================================================== output$pathway_table <- renderDT({ datatable( prepared$pathway_display, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", selection = list( mode = "multiple", target = "row" ), options = list( pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE, autoWidth = TRUE ), class = "compact stripe hover" ) }, server = FALSE) # ======================================================== # Selection status # ======================================================== output$selection_status <- renderText({ keys <- selected_gene_keys() paths <- selected_pathway_names() sprintf( "Selected pathways: %d | Matched genes: %d | %s", length(paths), length(keys), if (length(paths)) { paste( paths, collapse = "; " ) } else { "No pathway selected" } ) }) # ======================================================== # Volcano plot # ======================================================== output$volcano <- renderGirafe({ dat <- prepared$gene_table keys <- selected_gene_keys() # ---------------------------------------------------- # Mark selected genes # ---------------------------------------------------- dat$selected <- dat$gene_key %in% keys dat$point_alpha <- if (length(keys)) { ifelse( dat$selected, 1, 0.16 ) } else { 0.7 } dat$point_size <- ifelse( dat$selected, 2.8, 1.7 ) # ---------------------------------------------------- # Tooltip # ---------------------------------------------------- dat$tooltip <- sprintf( paste0( "Gene: %s
", "logFC: %s
", "P-value: %s%s" ), dat$gene_label, format( dat$gene_effect, digits = 3 ), format( dat$gene_p, digits = 3, scientific = TRUE ), ifelse( dat$selected, "
Selected pathway gene", "" ) ) # ---------------------------------------------------- # Main plot # ---------------------------------------------------- p <- ggplot( dat, aes( x = gene_effect, y = neg_log_p ) ) + geom_point_interactive( aes( colour = sig, alpha = point_alpha, size = point_size, tooltip = tooltip, data_id = gene_key ) ) + scale_colour_manual( values = c( Down = "#0072B2", NS = "#CBD5E1", Up = "#D55E00" ), drop = FALSE, name = NULL ) + scale_alpha_identity( guide = "none" ) + scale_size_identity( guide = "none" ) + geom_hline( yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", colour = "#64748B", linewidth = 0.4 ) + geom_vline( xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", colour = "#64748B", linewidth = 0.4 ) + labs( x = "logFC", y = expression( -log[10](P) ) ) + theme_minimal( base_size = 12 ) + theme( panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom", plot.margin = margin( 8, 12, 8, 12 ) ) # ---------------------------------------------------- # Add outline around selected genes # ---------------------------------------------------- selected_dat <- dat[ dat$selected, , drop = FALSE ] if (nrow(selected_dat)) { p <- p + geom_point_interactive( data = selected_dat, aes( x = gene_effect, y = neg_log_p, tooltip = tooltip, data_id = gene_key ), inherit.aes = FALSE, shape = 21, fill = NA, colour = "#111827", stroke = 1.1, size = 4.2 ) } # ---------------------------------------------------- # Interactive ggiraph object # ---------------------------------------------------- girafe( ggobj = p, options = list( opts_hover( css = "stroke:#111827;stroke-width:2px;opacity:1;" ), opts_toolbar( saveaspng = TRUE ) ) ) }) # ======================================================== # Selected genes table # ======================================================== output$selected_genes <- renderDT({ keys <- selected_gene_keys() if (!length(keys)) { return( datatable( data.frame( Message = "Select one or more pathways above." ), rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = "t") ) ) } rows <- prepared$gene_table$gene_key %in% keys selected <- prepared$gene_table[ rows, c( "gene_label", "gene_effect", "gene_p", "sig" ), drop = FALSE ] # ---------------------------------------------------- # Pathways for each selected gene # ---------------------------------------------------- selected$pathways <- vapply( prepared$gene_table$gene_key[rows], function(key) { hits <- vapply( prepared$pathway_table$gene_keys, function(x) { key %in% x }, logical(1) ) paste( prepared$pathway_table$pathway[ hits & seq_along(hits) %in% selected_rows() ], collapse = "; " ) }, character(1) ) names(selected) <- c( "Gene", "logFC", "PValue", "Direction", "Selected pathways" ) datatable( selected, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", options = list( pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE ), class = "compact stripe hover" ) }, server = FALSE) # ======================================================== # Diagnostics # ======================================================== output$diagnostics <- renderText({ pt <- prepared$pathway_table sprintf( paste0( "Pathways: %d\n", "Pathways with >=1 matched gene: %d\n", "Genes in gene_data: %d\n", "Genes referenced by pathways: %d\n", "Matched gene IDs: %d" ), nrow(pt), sum( pt$matched_count > 0 ), nrow( prepared$gene_table ), length( unique( unlist( pt$gene_keys, use.names = FALSE ) ) ), length( prepared$matched_gene_keys ) ) }) } # ============================================================ # 6. Start Shiny application # ============================================================ shinyApp( ui = ui, server = server )
